description: This file is a header (.h) file defining interfaces for the CCSP Message Bus Service, including function declarations, constants, and external references related to message bus operations in an embedded Linux environment.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_GetHealth
methods.description: Retrieves the health status of the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources with specified priority and user data.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_SendParameterValueChangeSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating a parameter value change.

methods.name: CcspTandD_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles incoming DBus messages for the path.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_RegisterToCR
methods.description: Registers the interface to the Configuration Registry.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_WaitConditionReady
methods.description: Waits until a specific condition on the message bus is ready.
